composition: L-shaped brick manor and octagonal gatehouse spire across the moat · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Kasteel Arcen is an L-shaped brick manor with slate hipped roofs, seen with the 1653 gatehouse and its octagonal slate spire across the moat. It is not a four-tower castle. The gardens are closed and are not a flower display. It is clear, about 10.2°C, with wind near 7.6 km/h and cloud cover about 0%. No coat of arms is readable.

qc_notes.note: Gate 1 hold (Cosmo QC 2026-09-26, verified by Cosmo's own read of both masters): the two formats disagree on the building's massing - the 16x9 shows a symmetrical brick manor block with a central pediment, an external curved double staircase, and a separate spired gatehouse tower off to the right connected by a wall, while the 4x5 shows one integrated complex with a tall spired tower centered between brick wings, no staircase and no separate gatehouse. Card anchors (gatehouse with the manor on the island beyond, L-shaped manor) match the 16x9 and contradict the 4x5. Builder to align the renders and re-push.

Gate 1 re-audit PASS (Cosmo QC 2026-09-26): re-rendered masters re-verified - both formats show the same L-shaped brick manor with dark slate hipped roofs, dormers, chimneys and warmly lit windows; the earlier massing discrepancy is resolved. On-image strings and Art. 50 metadata verified on the new masters. Hold resolved.
